meeting-to-actions: Each action names one accountable person rather than a team, a calendar date rather than a relative phrase like 'next week', and a verbatim transcript quote showing the commitment was actually made. Discussion that never became a commitment is not an action.
policy-compliance-check: Each finding cites the specific policy clause id it breaches and quotes the document text that breaches it. A finding that restates a policy without pointing at non-compliant text is not a finding.
rfp-response-assembler: Every numbered requirement is either answered from the knowledge base with its source, or explicitly flagged as unanswerable — silence on a requirement is a failure, not an omission. The assembled document is within the RFP's stated page limit.
vendor-comparison-matrix: Every cell cites the vendor document and section it came from, and all vendors are scored on the identical criteria set. A criterion applied to one vendor but not another makes the matrix incomparable rather than merely incomplete.
blog-production-pipeline: The draft passes the house style guide on voice, heading depth and sentence length, and no passage matches published text beyond an incidental phrase.
localization-pipeline: Each locale's back-translation stays above the similarity threshold against the source, and every glossary term uses its approved target-language equivalent. A fluent translation that renames the product is a failure.
seo-optimization-loop: The page clears the score threshold for its target queries while still reading naturally: keyword density that trips a stuffing flag fails even at a passing score.
screenplay-coverage: The verdict is one of pass, consider or recommend, and is defended against at least two named comparable titles and how they performed. A recommendation with no market comparison is an opinion, not coverage.
ux-research-synthesis: Every insight is grounded in at least two distinct participants. A theme one person raised is a quote, not a finding.
escalation-summarizer: Every unresolved customer ask appears in the brief with a verbatim quote and its current state. An ask the thread left hanging is exactly what the receiving tier must not have to rediscover.
kb-article-generator: The steps, followed literally by someone who never saw the ticket, reproduce the resolution — and the article does not duplicate an existing one covering the same symptom.
sales-call-scorer: The score reports the median across independent passes and the spread between them. A tight spread is a confident score; a wide one must be surfaced, not averaged into a single number that hides the disagreement.
ticket-triage-swarm: The queue each ticket was routed to matches the labeled backlog, and priority reflects the customer's stated impact rather than the tone they used to state it.
ab-test-analysis: The effect recomputed from the raw data reproduces the claimed effect within tolerance, and the readout names the pitfalls that could still invalidate it — peeking, unequal exposure, or a metric that moved for an unrelated reason.
anomaly-investigation: The classification into seasonal, data-bug or real-change agrees with the holdout labels, and cites the comparison window and series that distinguishes the three. Every anomaly looks real without the seasonal baseline beside it.
data-quality-audit: Every violation is a machine-readable rule id with the row count that breaks it, so the report can be re-run and diffed rather than re-read.
etl-pipeline-builder: An end-to-end run loads exactly the expected row count, and a second run loads no duplicates.
schema-migration-saga: The saga ends in one of two consistent states: forward-complete with source and target parity verified, or fully unwound with every executed step compensated. A partially applied migration is the outcome this graph exists to prevent.
sql-generation-verified: The query executes against the real schema and its result passes row-count sanity. A query returning zero rows from a populated table, or every row where a filter was asked for, is wrong even though it ran.
alert-noise-reduction: Clustering collapses a storm into one incident per underlying cause, and no alert that would have paged a human is suppressed. Missing one page outweighs any dedupe ratio.
deploy-canary-verifier: Either the canary's error rate stayed inside the budget, or the rollback fired. A canary that exceeded its threshold and was promoted anyway is the exact failure this node exists to catch.
incident-lifecycle: Mitigation is proven by the signal that declared the incident returning to normal, not by a responder saying so — and the postmortem yields at least one action with a named owner.
incident-triage-router: The team the incident was routed to owns the affected service in the current on-call map, and the severity reflects observed customer impact rather than the reporter's urgency.
postmortem-writer: Every timeline event cites the log line or chat message id it came from, and the narrative attributes cause to systems and decisions rather than to people.
runbook-executor: Each step's post-condition command exited zero. A step whose check was skipped is not a passed step.
self-healing-ci: The pipeline ends green, or escalates with the diagnosis attached — and every attempted repair is recorded with why it failed, so the next run does not retry what already did not work.
verifier-swarm: The goal's verification command exits zero against the merged result. Nothing merges on a worker's report that it finished; three failures escalate to a human rather than becoming a fourth attempt.
essay-feedback-critic: Every comment quotes the essay text it responds to and cites the rubric criterion it applies, so the student sees both what was read and what standard it was held to.
quiz-generation-verified: The critic, solving each item without seeing the key, arrives at the keyed answer — and each distractor is wrong for a reason a learner could plausibly hold, not obviously absurd.
rubric-grading-swarm: Inter-rater agreement clears the threshold, or the submission escalates to a human. Averaging graders who disagree produces a defensible-looking number from an undefended judgement.
earnings-call-digest: Every figure in the digest appears in the transcript. A number that is directionally right but never stated is an invented number.
expense-audit-swarm: Every violation names the expense line id and the specific policy rule it breaches, so the claimant can see what to fix rather than that something was wrong.
kyc-document-processing: Every extracted field validates against the document image it came from, and a field that could not be read is flagged as a gap rather than inferred from the rest of the pack.
adverse-event-scanner: Every signal cites exactly the report ids counted in it, so the count is reproducible from the citation and a reviewer can pull the source reports.
clinical-literature-triage: The study-type and evidence-level labels agree with the validated sample, and the level reflects the study design as reported rather than the strength of its conclusions.
differential-diagnosis-ensemble: The ranked differential carries the quorum supporting it, and any diagnostician's dissent is reported alongside. The rare diagnosis one reviewer insisted on is the signal, not the noise.
medical-coding-audit: Every assigned code points at the note span that documents it. A code the chart supports only by inference is an unsupported code, however clinically likely.
jd-drafting-critic: The description is clean of gendered and coded bias terms, and requirements are deduplicated and separated into must-have and nice-to-have. An inflated requirement list narrows the pool without raising the bar.
onboarding-plan-builder: Each 30/60/90 checkpoint carries a milestone an observer could mark done or not done, and every system the role needs on day one is requested before the start date. 'Get up to speed' is not a milestone.
performance-cycle-summarizer: Every statement cites the self, peer or manager input it came from, and no recency or halo bias flag survives calibration. An uncited claim in a performance summary is hearsay.
contract-redline-pipeline: Every redline cites the playbook position it enforces and says what risk the original language creates. A stylistic edit with no playbook reference is noise in a negotiation.
ediscovery-triage: Recall on the seeded relevant set clears the threshold, and privilege calls are conservative: a document wrongly released cannot be recalled, while one wrongly withheld can still be produced.
gdpr-data-audit: Every store holding personal data carries a lawful basis, and every gap carries a named owner and a due date. An unclassified store is the finding, not an omission from the report.
license-compliance-scan: Every package resolves to an SPDX identifier, and any copyleft obligation incompatible with the distribution model is flagged. A package whose licence could not be determined is a conflict until proven otherwise.
returns-triage: The route agrees with the policy decision table for the stated reason code, and anything routed to fraud review cites the specific pattern that triggered it rather than a general suspicion.
supplier-risk-monitor: Every supplier above the risk appetite has a mitigation with a named owner, and single-source dependencies are flagged even when the supplier is currently performing well. Concentration risk is about what happens when they stop.
citation-integrity-audit: Every citation resolves to a real, reachable source, and the cited passage actually supports the claim it is attached to. A resolving link under a claim it does not support is the harder failure and the one this node exists for.
competitive-intelligence: Every finding links a dated public source. An undated observation cannot be told apart from a stale one, which is the whole risk in a competitive brief.
cost-routed-research: Every claim in the synthesis cites at least one source, and anything the cheap path could not verify is labelled as unverified rather than dropped or stated plainly.
fact-check-pipeline: Every verdict carries the source URL and the quoted span that settles it, so a reader can check the check. A verdict without a quote span is an assertion about an assertion.
literature-review-swarm: Every claim cites the specific paper and the section within it. A claim citing a paper but not where in it stops the next reader from verifying anything.
prompt-graph-optimization: A variant ships only if it beats the baseline on a held-out set it was never searched against. A winner selected on the set that selected it has measured its own search, not its quality.
compliance-evidence-collector: Every control is either evidenced with a live artefact or named explicitly in the uncovered list. The totals must reconcile: a control that is silently neither is how an audit finds what the collector missed.
forensic-investigation-blackboard: Every conclusion cites the evidence on the blackboard that supports it, and questions the investigation could not settle are stated as open rather than dropped. A clean narrative that omits its gaps is the failure mode of an investigation.
phishing-triage: Verdicts agree with the labeled corpus, and anything confirmed as phishing cites the specific indicator — sender mismatch, lookalike domain, credential-harvesting target — rather than a general impression of suspicion.
red-team-blue-team-hardening: The loop terminates because the attacker exhausted its options with every finding mitigated, producing evidence of absence rather than absence of evidence. An unmitigated finding means the loop stopped early.
soc-alert-investigation: The conclusion is supported by the query results attached to it, and the queries were driven by a stated hypothesis rather than assembled after the answer was chosen.
threat-intel-digest: Every item links its source advisory and the CVE ids it concerns, and relevance is judged against the estate actually run rather than the severity score in isolation.
vuln-prioritization: Every ranked item cites the scanner evidence and the asset-map reference that give it exposure. A CVSS score without an asset map ranks a vulnerability nobody can reach above one on the perimeter.
vuln-remediation-lifecycle: The recorded proof-of-concept no longer succeeds against the patched build, demonstrated by re-running it rather than by inspecting the diff. Nothing is disclosed before that re-run passes and a human has signed off.
architecture-decision-tournament: At least three independent designs were scored on one rubric, and the decision names the runner-up and the margin over it, so the choice can be revisited when the evidence changes rather than re-argued from scratch.
benchmark-driven-optimization-search: The retained candidate is measurably faster than baseline on the real benchmark with the suite green. A candidate that is faster because it stopped doing the work is the failure this node catches.
bug-triage-and-fix: The regression test fails against the unpatched code and passes against the patched code. A test that passes before the fix is testing something else.
code-review-pipeline: The verdict is approve or request_changes, and every finding names the file and line it is about. A review comment that cannot be located in the diff cannot be acted on.
dependency-upgrade: The lockfile is updated, the suite passes, and no new deprecation warning was introduced. A green suite that emits deprecations has deferred the breakage to the next upgrade, not avoided it.
docs-code-sync-audit: Every code example extracted from the docs was actually executed and exited zero. An example that was read and judged plausible has not been checked.
flaky-test-reflexion: Stability is shown by at least three consecutive green runs, not one, and every failed attempt is recorded with what it ruled out so the next attempt does not repeat it.
framework-migration: The build and the full suite are green on the target stack with no slice left unported. A partially migrated codebase that passes because the unported half is untested is the outcome the slice count exists to prevent.
legacy-refactor: The characterization snapshots are identical before and after. A refactor is a change in structure and in nothing else; any behavioural difference means it was a rewrite.
performance-optimization: The benchmark is under the target budget with no test regressions, and the measurement is of the same workload as the baseline. Comparing a tuned run against an untuned one on different input measures nothing.
release-notes-generation: Every note links the merged PR it describes, and no note claims a change that no PR made. An orphan claim in release notes becomes a support ticket.
test-suite-generation: Coverage increases and the mutation score beats the baseline. A test that executes a line without asserting anything about it raises coverage and catches nothing, which is exactly what mutation score exists to detect.
